# superset_dashboard_embedding (Resource)

Makes a dashboard embeddable in other applications with the Superset embedded SDK. Guest tokens for the embedded dashboard require the `EMBEDDED_SUPERSET` feature flag in Superset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_dashboard_embedding" "signups" {
  dashboard_id    = superset_dashboard.signups.id
  allowed_domains = ["https://app.example.com", "https://portal.example.com"]
}

# The embedded SDK loads the dashboard by this uuid.
output "signups_embedded_uuid" {
  value = superset_dashboard_embedding.signups.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowed_domains` (Set of String) Origins allowed to embed the dashboard, for example `https://app.example.com`. An empty set allows every origin.
- `dashboard_id` (Number) Identifier of the dashboard to embed. Changing it replaces the configuration, which gives the embedded dashboard a new uuid.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Identifier of the embedding configuration, which is the identifier of the dashboard.
- `uuid` (String) Identifier under which the embedded SDK loads the dashboard.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The embedding configuration is imported by the numeric id of its dashboard.
terraform import superset_dashboard_embedding.signups 17
```
